# ci/cd: configure dependabot

Let Dependabot bump the Go tools instead of filing an issue per release by hand. **Motivation:** "automate updating go tools" — by May 2022 the tracker had dozens of `up esbuild to vX`, `up octosql to vY` tickets ([#298](DOT-297.md) onward), each a one-line `go.mod` change. Inspiration: the `dependabot.yml` files of [spf13/cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra/blob/master/.github/dependabot.yml) and [golangci-lint](https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/blob/master/.github/dependabot.yml).
